summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K with certifications under Canadian securities legislation (Form 52-109F2) for its interim financial report and MD&A for the period ended July 31, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a routine regulatory certification by the CEO and CFO regarding disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting. No deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual corporate events are present. This is a routine current report with no special-situation relevance.
